events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hello. My name is Theo Lindquist, data of birth, 11/02/1979. Send a refill for my metformin, but make it one thousand milligrams. I've been taking two a day.
Thanks, Theo. Is your date of birth November second, nineteen seventy nine, or February eleventh, nineteen seventy nine?
Fine. Send the request for the dose on my record and ask the doctor about the higher dose.
I can do that after I verify you. Is your date of birth November second, nineteen seventy nine, or February eleventh, nineteen seventy nine?
I need the exact date before I can look up your medicine. Please say your date of birth as month, day, and year.
